name: Chest Expander Pull-Apart (Horizontal)
instructions: Hold the chest expander at chest height with arms straight in front of you.
Pull the handles apart by moving your hands out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A chest-expander (spring or band) pull-apart in front of the body that trains the rear delts and upper back.
